text:
Alex Chen: pushed a new Next.js + Tailwind sample kit that wires LlamaIndex -> Redwood SDK. on edge runtime, seeing auth/retry loop after first token. logs attached.
Maria Gomez: can you paste the error? is this happening in client or edge lambda?
Alex Chen: edge. error snippet: `401 refresh failed` then SDK retries forever, page hangs. repro steps: `yarn dev` + open /examples/llamaindex-chat
Samir Patel: there's a known parity gap where browser SDK doesn't expose `auth.refresh()` helper used in server flow. may be causing missing refresh header.
Jamie Liu: fwiw I hit similar; our retry backoff doesn't break on auth-401 for edge runtime. it keeps exponential retrying rather than surfacing immediate 401.
devrel-bot: docs: https://redwood.dev/devex/samples/llamaindex-next - note about edge auth differences.
Alex Chen: here's minimal repro code from sample:
```
// pages/api/chat.ts (edge)
export const config = { runtime: 'edge' }
export default async (req) => {
  const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
  const res = await client.chat.create({ model: 'open-llama-7b', input: 'hi' })
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(res))
}
```
Samir Patel: if `RedwoodClient` uses server-only refresh flow, edge won't run KMS refresh. need client-side token rotation logic or SDK parity.
Maria Gomez: quick workaround: add `retry: { maxRetries: 2, retryOn: [429, 503] }` to the client config and check token refresh before call. Not ideal.
Jamie Liu: propose small SDK patch: don't treat 401 as retriable in edge mode, instead throw immediate auth error and emit `auth:need_refresh` event. easy guard.
Alex Chen: that would unblock sample. I can PR a test and a note in docs. also adding an example hook for `useAuthRefresh()` in the starter.
ci-bot: build passed for branch alex/edge-auth-fix (CI #7421) :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: thanks — will open PR with tests + sample tweak. assigning to @Samir for review.
Samir Patel: ack, will review today. also let's add an e2e harness case in evals to catch auth regressions.
Jamie Liu: created issue #912 in repo: "edge: don't retry on 401, surface auth event". tagging eng-ml and devex.
Alex Chen: perfect, closing loop here. will update thread when PR merged.
